# Adds the orders.status index with a production-safe strategy for a
# high-write table.
#
# Considerations applied:
#   - The index is built with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY so writes keep
#     flowing during the build instead of blocking behind the lock a
#     plain CREATE INDEX takes.
#   - Concurrent index creation cannot run inside a transaction block,
#     so disable_ddl_transaction! opts out of the migration's default
#     ddl transaction.
#   - if_not_exists makes a rerun after a failed deploy deterministic:
#     a repeated migration does not fail on the leftover index.
#   - If a concurrent build fails midway, PostgreSQL leaves an INVALID
#     index behind; recovery is to drop that index concurrently and
#     rerun, then verify the index is valid and actually used by the
#     target query plan.
class AddOrdersStatusIndex < ActiveRecord::Migration[8.1]
  disable_ddl_transaction!

  def change
    add_index :orders, :status, algorithm: :concurrently, if_not_exists: true
  end
end
